readings: Using the feature records (`scanfeatures`) and ignoring missing detected-feature counts (`traitcount`), take each record's count on its own, without combining records of the same site code, so a site can appear more than once. Work out each record's share of the overall feature total, and keep only those whose share is above the average share across records. For the 10 with the largest margin above that average, list the site code, its feature count, its share, and how far its share exceeds the average share, from the largest margin down. Don't round.
queries:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT zoneref, traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS total FROM f
),
s AS (
  SELECT f.zoneref, f.traitcount, CAST(f.traitcount AS REAL) / t.total AS share
  FROM f, t
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT s.zoneref, s.traitcount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS margin
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
